description: Start a local web UI (Rive-editor-like 3-pane layout) for live-previewing and editing a .riv file: hierarchy tree + click/drag selection on canvas + inspector (position/size/color/text edits apply live), timeline with keyframe markers, hot reload on file change, auto-generated state machine input controls, event log, and (with scenePath) direct scene-JSON editing. The UI also has an 'Instructions for AI' box — fetch those with riv_studio_notes. Re-running riv_create/riv_edit on the watched file updates the browser instantly. Only one studio runs at a time.

path.description: The .riv file to preview (watched for changes)

scenePath.description: Scene spec JSON path — enables the edit+rebuild panel

name: riv_studio
title: Start the local Studio web UI
